title: Cartwise Gift Cards Terms: Lapse of Bonus Value and Card Expiry
content:
Purchased value on a Cartwise Gift Cards card never expires, and the monthly inactivity fee is 0.00 for every card. Bonus value on a Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card lapses when the bonus period counted from activation has run.

## Terms

**1. Purchased value.** Purchased value never expires, on any card type.

**2. Inactivity.** The inactivity fee is 0.00 for every card.

**3. Bonus period.** Bonus value on a Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card lapses when the bonus period counted from activation has run. The bonus period is counted in calendar days with the card's activation date as day 0, and bonus value lapses on the day after the activation date plus the card type's bonus period in days. On the last day of the period — the activation date plus the bonus period — the bonus has not yet lapsed; it lapses from the following day.

**4. What the lapse removes.** The lapse removes only the bonus value still remaining on the card, booked as a removal for bonus expiry. The bonus value remaining is the bonus value loaded onto the card, less the bonus part of the card's redemptions under its order of spending, less any bonus value already removed for bonus expiry. Purchased value is never touched by the lapse.

**5. Card expiry.** A card of a type whose value can expire moves to expired only when nothing but lapsed bonus value remained on it; the card moves from active to expired.

**6. Evidence.** The activation date is taken from the company's record of the card concerned.

## Boundary days (hypothetical inputs)

For a card type with a bonus period of 90 days, and a card activated on 1 March:

| Day | Count from activation | Bonus value |
|---|---|---|
| 1 March | day 0 | In force |
| 30 May | day 90 (activation date plus 90 days) | In force — last day |
| 31 May | day 91 | Lapsed |

The same count without dates: on day 90 the bonus is still in force, and on day 91 it has lapsed.

## Amount removed (hypothetical inputs)

A Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card was loaded with 20.00 of bonus value and 100.00 of purchased value. Its redemptions, spending bonus value first, used 12.00 of bonus value. No bonus value had yet been removed for expiry. The bonus value remaining at the lapse is 20.00 less 12.00 less 0.00, which is 8.00, and the lapse removes 8.00.

## Expiry of the card (hypothetical inputs)

| Value on the card when the bonus lapses | Can the card move to expired? |
|---|---|
| 8.00 of bonus value and no purchased value | Yes — nothing but lapsed bonus value remained |
| 8.00 of bonus value and 30.00 of purchased value | No — purchased value remains |
